stem.text: A man standing next to a stationary train hears sound of frequency $400\,\text{Hz}$ emitted from the train’s horn. The train then moves directly away from the man and sounds its horn when it has a speed of $50\,\text{m s}^{-1}$. The speed of sound is $340\,\text{m s}^{-1}$.
What is the difference in frequency of the sound heard by the man on the two occasions?
